method: same scenarios and ASR method as the baseline; 13 runs (build/critic/r1_*), faster-whisper small on 27 clips and medium on 6, python port of BroadcastSchedule, ./gradlew test --rerun (427 pass)

A.summary: Item frame now shows the radio front (display.fixed [0,0,0]). Models, facings and icon unchanged. On state still not lit at night (P-11).

B.summary: Power-off readout shows 'Off' with an empty bar and no 'locked'; weak stations show 'Weak signal' / 'Sinal fraco'; item hover tooltip wired (code and unit test, not visible in the harness). pt-PT wording nits and the needle over the 1000 label remain.

C1.summary: Noise bed -30 to -40 dBFS (tail floor -30.8 to -40.1). Whisper-medium WER 0.320 to 0.198 on six clips (0.330 to 0.182 on the five with an unchanged take, raw 0.132); whisper-small 0.403 to 0.335 on 27 clips (0.414 to 0.334 on 24 unchanged, raw 0.288). Three Lusitana clips re-synthesised and checked against their scripts. Remaining errors are mostly the Piper voice.

C2.summary: Unchanged: 72-85 s songs, 10-11 s chimes, -15.4 to -16.1 LUFS, no clipping. Judged by measurement.

C3.summary: Unchanged character: band-limit, compressor, crackle, run-time static and hiss, whistle, warm-up. Baked noise floor 9 dB lower. 100 Hz hum of carrier_hiss still there (P-07).

C4.summary: Four in-sync radios: peak 0.00 to -6.05 dBFS, clipped samples 198 to 0, level +5.5 to -3.5 dB re the clip (now 1.6 dB under one radio). Atlantico static 0.27 to 0.43 (13.8 to 9.8 dB under the programme). Loudness spread unchanged (-15.4 to -16.1 LUFS). Hum (P-07) and a slightly low crowd exponent (P-16) are left.

C5.summary: Unchanged: 1-d/64 within 0.5 dB from 4 to 62 blocks, silent from 64.

D.summary: False 'Radio static' subtitle gone: 43 of 61 static-subtitle seconds were false in 11 scenarios, 0 of 38 now. 42 of 42 sounds still covered in en and pt-PT; new key signal_weak in both files.

E1.summary: Unchanged: give, icon, recipe, loot, facing verified; real player placement not drivable.

E2.summary: Toggle behaviour unchanged and verified (pulse, falling edge, triple pulse, button) without the false static subtitle. Hint tooltip now wired (code only). Sneak+use not drivable; warm-up overlap (P-13) open.

E3.summary: No regression: readouts, clamping, keys, wheel, drag, whistle and block-entity sync as at baseline.

E4.summary: Unchanged for strong stations: fit 0.706 / 0.78, same level table from -30 dB (static only) to -19 dB (locked).

E5.summary: 1245 radio samples agree with the python port of BroadcastSchedule using the new Lusitana durations. Spoken hours now match the clock (cinco, dezoito, vinte horas). Dawn/dusk length and Lusitana night chime loop open (rest of P-08).

E6.summary: Off air by day, on at 13800, as before; now sounds weak (static 10 dB under the programme, 4.6 dB under Tejo) and the screen says 'Weak signal'.

E7.summary: Every snapshot identical to baseline: scope, late joiners, resume, clear, replace, errors, subtitle.

E8.summary: Offsets of four radios agree to 0.1 s for 150 s; fifth silent; peak fixed (-6 dBFS). Frozen-clock caveat (P-10) and keep-bonus silence open.

E9.summary: 13 logs with five constant vanilla WARN lines, none from the mod; 20.0 ticks/s; median 27-28 fps (software GL); 427 unit tests pass.

polish.suggestion: carrier_hiss is a 100 Hz mains hum (16% of energy below 130 Hz): high-pass near 300 Hz or take the line down 10 dB.
Dawn (100 s) and dusk (90 s) hold more than they can play; Lusitana night is signoff_1 plus about 43 chime repeats. (Spoken hours: done.)
pt-PT wording: 'Ligar' beside 'Ligado', 'Role para sintonizar', 'Telefonia chia'; halo for the needle over the '1000' label.
With doDaylightCycle false radios have no common clock; derive the schedule position from game time since the freeze.
Give the on state a light level or an emissive dial so it reads at night.
Case-insensitive station ids; usage line for /fadoecravo.
Hold the programme back for the 2.5 s tube warm-up.
Add use_item and sneak steps so real placement and sneak+use can be tested.
RadioMix.CROWD_EXPONENT 0.75 to about 0.65: four radios would sit at about one radio's level with a peak near -3 dBFS (now -1.6 dB under one radio, peak -6 dBFS).
Re-take Lusitana news_morning_1 (raw Whisper-medium WER 0.27 for the new take against 0.15 for the old one); target 0.15 or lower.
A ten-minute ear check of speech, music and the cleaner programme.
